speaker.name: Model Monica

output.objection: Automating the hand-over is just the plumbing, not the full ask. I need the monitoring to actually start and log accuracy the moment the forecast job finishes, without me touching a terminal.
output.correction: You filed that as a general automation request, but I specifically asked for the trigger to link the job completion directly to the monitoring start.
